name: MAS Vertical
tagline: One Fabric. Two Sides. Infinite Possibilities

keySpecification.description: Synchronized double-sided digital textile printing engineered for perfect front-to-back registration, yarn-dye replication, and high value-added production across both fabric faces in a single pass.

inkCompatibility.description: An up-to-8-color ink system supporting full-gamut reproduction across both fabric sides simultaneously, with digital yarn-dye replication that eliminates the time and cost of physical yarn dyeing.

inkTypes.name: Multi-Color Ink System
inkTypes.fabrics: Up to 8 installed colors supporting full-gamut reproduction across both fabric sides simultaneously

inkTypes.name: Yarn-Dye Replication
inkTypes.fabrics: Digital ink layering engineered to replicate complex, traditional yarn-dye effects without the time and cost of physical yarn dyeing

inkTypes.name: Color Spectrum
inkTypes.fabrics: Up to 8-color configuration enabling synchronized colour matching, two-colorway production, or two entirely independent designs on a single fabric pass

features.description: Engineered for synchronized dual-side output with perfect registration, integrated real-time image processing, and complete dual-zone drying for value-added textile production.

items.title: Synchronized Double-Sided Printing System
items.desc: Dual-carriage Kyocera KJ4B printheads achieve perfect front-to-back registration, printing the same design, two different colorways, or two completely different designs on a single fabric in one pass.

items.title: Built-In Image Processor
items.desc: Integrated onboard image processing handles dual-side design data in real time, ensuring perfectly synchronized output between the front and back print engines without external processing delays.

items.title: Dual-Zone Drying System
items.desc: Rear-side IR panel (9 kW) combined with a dual-side forced air heater (18 kW) ensures both fabric faces are fully and evenly dried before collection, preventing smudging or colour transfer.

items.title: Yarn-Dye Effect Replication Technology
items.desc: Advanced colour engine digitally reproduces complex traditional yarn-dye patterns and effects, eliminating the lengthy weaving and dyeing process required for authentic yarn-dye fabric production.

items.title: Flexible Print Width Configuration
items.desc: Supports fabric widths from 900 mm to 1850 mm, giving manufacturers the flexibility to run narrow shirting fabrics and wider denim or technical textile substrates on the same platform.

items.title: Optional Sewing Machine Integration
items.desc: Inline sewing machine integration is available as an add-on, enabling continuous fabric processing from printing directly through to seaming within a single production line.

items.title: Optional Centering Device
items.desc: Automatic fabric centering add-on ensures consistent alignment entering the dual-side print zone, maintaining registration accuracy across varying fabric widths and roll conditions.

items.title: Industrial Power and Pneumatic Architecture
items.desc: 400V triphase power supply with 44 kW total installed capacity and 6 bar pneumatics ensures stable, consistent operation of both print carriages and the drying system under continuous production loads.

items.title: Supply Chain Efficiency
items.desc: Collapses traditional production lead times from months to days while significantly reducing waste and environmental pollution across the textile supply chain.

idealFor.description: Built for value-added, design-driven textile production where synchronized double-sided printing, perfect registration, and digital yarn-dye replication unlock new possibilities.

fabrics.title: Denim Manufacturing
fabrics.desc: Synchronized double-sided printing enables true reversible denim and complex face-and-back colour effects that conventional single-side printers cannot replicate, opening new design possibilities for denim mills.

fabrics.title: High Fashion and Accessories
fabrics.desc: Two-colorway and dual-design capability on a single fabric pass gives fashion brands and accessory manufacturers the flexibility to create reversible garments and dual-pattern accessories from one production run.

fabrics.title: Technical Textiles
fabrics.desc: Print width flexibility from 900 mm to 1850 mm combined with industrial drying capacity suits technical textile producers requiring precise, dual-sided functional or pattern printing.

productionCapacity.description: Synchronized double-sided mode at 600 dpi across 900–1850 mm. Production speed is determined by registration precision and dual-side drying requirements rather than single-pass throughput alone, making the Vertical best suited to value-added, design-driven production rather than high-volume commodity printing.

globalComponents.description: Built using premium global components engineered for synchronized dual-side operation, complete drying, and stable continuous production.

largeCard.title: Kyocera KJ4B (Japan)
largeCard.desc: Dual-carriage 600 dpi printheads enabling synchronized double-sided printing with perfect front-to-back registration

smallCards.title: Built-In Image Processor
smallCards.desc: Integrated onboard processing engine managing real-time dual-side design synchronization

smallCards.title: Dual-Zone Drying System
smallCards.desc: Rear IR panel (9 kW) and dual-side forced air heater (18 kW) for complete, even drying across both fabric faces

smallCards.title: Industrial Power System
smallCards.desc: 400V triphase supply with 44 kW total installed power for stable dual-engine operation under continuous production

smallCards.title: Pneumatic Control System
smallCards.desc: 6 bar pressure system with up to 20 L/min compressed air consumption supporting precise mechanical operation

smallCards.title: Optional Sewing Machine Module
smallCards.desc: Inline integration enabling continuous printing-to-seaming production workflow

smallCards.title: Optional Centering Device
smallCards.desc: Automated fabric alignment system maintaining registration accuracy across varying fabric widths
